reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. Unless Humana policy or guidance directs otherwise, Humana requires providers to bill codes and other claims data according to the following:

1. Applicable Original Medicare and Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) guidance, if any; or

2. Otherwise, the applicable industry standard established by the appropriate authority. Examples include:

Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) coding standards by the American Medical Association (AMA);

837 electronic transaction standards by the American National Standards Institute (ANSI) X12;

International Classification of Diseases, Tenth Revision, Clinical Modifications (ICD-10-CM) coding standards by the

Standards for reporting institutional claims by the National Uniform Billing Committee (NUBC).
